info.gregecore.fission1: Abilities: Nuclear Fission and Parallel Hatch
info.gregecore.fission2: The Fission Reactor stands as a monument to high-yield power generation, harnessing the volatile force of nuclear splitting to yield immense energy. Without rigorous thermal management, the reactor can swiftly cascade toward catastrophic meltdown.
info.gregecore.fission3: When working, the reactor generates heat every 20 ticks. The amount depends on the recipe you're using. If there is coolant in the coolant input, it uses 10mb of coolant per 5 ticks to cool the heat. Below are the avaible coolants and their cooling power. You need to put coolants in the coolant input, the superheated version will come out of the coolant output. If you do not cool the reactor, it will explode. Maximal safe heat is 3000K. You can see the current values inside the controller.
info.gregecore.fusion1: Abilities: Heat Management and Perfect Overclock
info.gregecore.fusion2: Due to an engineering mistake, this reactor needs a working recipe or Superheated Solar Plasma to maintain heat. Somehow that heat from Superheated Solar Plasma allows this machine to take in huge amounts of resources and fuse them way faster than conventional fusion reactors.
info.gregecore.fusion4: Loses 100K/s without Superheated Solar Plasma. Gains 50K/s with Superheated Solar Plasma.
info.gregecore.fusion6: Generates 60K/s. Use Deionized Water to cool by 60K/s.
info.gregecore.fusion7: Maximum heat of the reactor is 7500K.
info.gregecore.fusion8: Put the coolant fluid into the Advanced Coolant Input.
info.gregecore.fusion9: Put the heater fluid into the Advanced Heater Input.
info.gregecore.gcr1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock and Bacterial Infestation
info.gregecore.gcr2: This machine is the pinnacle of bioengineering, thanks to special bred bacteria it can reach new heights. Depending on the bacteria inserted in a Bacteria Input, the machine posseses different abilities.
info.gregecore.gcr14: The machine can only have 1 active bacteria boost, place the bacteria which boost you want in the Bacteria Input.
info.gregecore.epicparallel1: Allows to run up to 1024 recipes in parallel.
info.gregecore.bigmulti1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Parallel Hatch and Threading
info.gregecore.bigmulti6: Created for ultra-fast extracting and canning.
info.gregecore.bigmulti11: Available Recipe Types: Distillation Tower, Distillery
info.gregecore.bigmulti16: Available Recipe Types: Bender, Compressor, Forge Hammer and Forming Press
info.gregecore.bigmulti26: Available Recipe Types: Centrifuge and Thermal Centrifuge
info.gregecore.bigmulti28: Available Recipe Types: Electromagnetic Separator and Polarizer
info.gregecore.bigmulti38: Available Recipe Types: Lathe and Cutter
info.gregecore.bigmulti42: Available Recipe Types: Brewery, Fermenter and Fluid Heater
info.gregecore.spectrometer1: Abilities: Dimension Simulating, Perfect Overclock and Parallel Hatch
info.gregecore.spectrometer2: A multiblock capable of simulating a dimension's atmosphere and subsequently extracting gases from it. Just be careful not to cause a Resonance Cascade.
info.gregecore.spectrometer3: If you provide it with Dimensional Simulator Maintenance Hatch, and input correct items into Dimensional Relics Input, the machine will ignore the dimension requirement.
info.gregecore.spectrometer7: Forge Smoke, Abyssal Air, Small Pile Of Impure Ancient Metal Dust and Ignitium Infused Lava
info.gregecore.spectrometer9: Enderium Air, Empty Lava Power Cell Imitation, Captured Lightning and Cursed Air
info.gregecore.spectrometer11: Earth Orbit, Venus Orbit, Mercury Orbit and Mars Orbit
info.gregecore.spectrometer13: Neptune Orbit, Uranus Orbit, Saturn Orbit, Jupiter Orbit and Sedna Sample Dust
info.gregecore.autassembly1: Abilities: Assembly Line, Perfect Overclock and Threading
info.gregecore.autassembly2: Are you tired of making a lot of Assembly Lines for only 1 recipe? Well have I got a solution for you.
info.gregecore.autassembly3: This multiblock allows you to craft Assembly Lines recipes without the need to place the inputs in correct slots. You have to use Optical Data Reception Hatch to input the data.
info.gregecore.cathedral2: Altar that can reproduce certain aspects of the real Blood Magic, but it has its limits.
info.gregecore.cathedral3: Insert Blood drops in the Blood Input to increase the amount of blood stored in the machine. Crafts demand certain amount of blood to be present, then they consume it.
info.gregecore.cathedral5: Tiny Drop Of Blood -> Consumes for 1mb of Blood
info.gregecore.cathedral6: Drop Of Blood -> Consumes for 5mb of Blood
info.gregecore.cathedral7: Large Drop Of Blood -> Consumes for 25mb of Blood
info.gregecore.infusionaltar2: Combines technology with arcane arts, to perform magical material synthesis.
info.gregecore.infusionaltar3: Technology believed to be lost in old versions, was resurrected to help you in your journey.
info.gregecore.infusionaltar4: Put items in the Infusion Altar Pedestals and input essentia in the correct essentia input.
info.gregecore.infusionaltar5: Then watch as the beautiful animation unfolds.
info.gregecore.pressurechamber4: Prevents explosion when pressure exceeds 100 Pa.
info.gregecore.pressurechamber6: Provides you with the power to compact different materials very tightly together. But be careful, as the glasses might not be able to withstand the pressures.
info.gregecore.pressurechamber7: Provide a Pressure Input with steam and the pressure inside the machine will start increasing with the rate of 1Pa per 1000mb of steam every second. Different glasses can withstand different amount of pressure. Do not mix them, as that will create leaks and the machine will not be able to work. You can also turn off the safe mode, which will result in halving the recipe times. But the machine can explode as consequence, if the pressure is too big.
info.gregecore.pressurechamber12: Controller sends out redstone signal, with every 7Pa adds 1 redstone strength.
info.gregecore.aebf1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Magical Coils and Threading
info.gregecore.aebf2: Avaible coils: Manasteel, Twilight and Desh
info.gregecore.aebf3: The machine starts speeding up with the power of the magic remnants in the coils. Depending on the coil, the machine speeds up faster. The coils tell you the exact amount of recipe time reduction.
info.gregecore.aebf4: The machine only accepts 16 of the same coil. Do not mix them. After the machine forms, you can see activated Magical Coil abilities in the controller.
info.gregecore.gaebf1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Magical Coils and Threading
info.gregecore.gaebf2: Avaible coils: Malachite, Forgotten and Superelement-27
info.gregecore.gaebf3: The machine starts speeding up with the power of the magic remnants in the coils. Depending on the coil, the machine speeds up faster. The coils tell you the exact amount of recipe time reduction.
info.gregecore.gaebf4: The power of the coils grow. Now they are able to work in parallel, but due to the intense heat generated, they require
info.gregecore.gaebf6: The machine only accepts 32 of the same coil. Do not mix them. After the machine forms, you can see activated Magical Coil abilities in the controller.
info.gregecore.gaebf7: Put the coolant in the Coolant Input. This machine only works with the basic version.
info.gregecore.laebf1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Learning and Threading
info.gregecore.laebf2: This machine is able to optimize its processes, greatly increasing its capabilities by reducing the energy usage, speeding the recipes up and adding more parallels.
info.gregecore.laebf3: T1: Blast 15000 items with 1K or higher blasting temperature.
info.gregecore.laebf5: T2: Blast 10000 items with 3000K or higher blasting temperature.
info.gregecore.laebf6: Reward: 30% Energy reduction and 50% speed boost.
info.gregecore.laebf7: T3: Blast 4000 items with 5000K or higher blasting temperature.
info.gregecore.laebf8: Reward: 15% Energy reduction, 30% speed boost and 16 parallels.
info.gregecore.laebf9: T4: Blast 2000 items with 7000K or higher blasting temperature.
info.gregecore.laebf11: T5: Blast 1000 items with 9000K or higher blasting temperature.
info.gregecore.laebf13: You can check your progress in the GUI of the machine controller.
info.gregecore.gabs1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Parallel Hatch and Threading
info.gregecore.bigfreezer1: Abilities: Improved Cooling, Perfect Overclock and Threading
info.gregecore.bigfreezer2: This freezer can cool inputs faster than the base one, but requires a bit of help with it.
info.gregecore.bigfreezer3: Due to the older model of the freezing device, it requires a
info.gregecore.bigfreezer6: Base version: 4 parallels and 10% recipe time reduction.
info.gregecore.bigfreezer7: With parallel multiplication part: 8 parallels and 20% recipe time reduction.
info.gregecore.bigfreezer8: With enhanced parallel multiplication part: 16 parallels and 30% recipe time reduction.
info.gregecore.enhancedblastchiller1: Abilities: Glacial Core, Perfect Overclock and Threading
info.gregecore.enhancedblastchiller2: This freezer gets better with every core you supply it. Each core improves the speed at which the machine is chilling the inputs.
info.gregecore.enhancedblastchiller3: For every Glacial Core in this machine, it gets 16 parallels and 6.5% faster recipes. Maximum Glacial Cores in a machine is 14, minimum is 3.
info.gregecore.assemblyhall2: An erratic piece of technology, seemingly incapable of compacting outer machine shells on its own. Providing a physical outline might assist the process.
info.gregecore.assemblyhall3: Each recipe requires a specific 3x3x3 hollow cube to be built inside the structure (indicated by red blocks in the preview). Place the required blocks in this exact location; the machine will consume them upon activation. The recipe can't start without it.
info.gregecore.genesiscrucible2: This machine is not strong enough on its own to operate at this voltage, so it needs help with processing components. Each cartridge unlocks new recipes.
info.gregecore.genesiscrucible3: Cartridges in crafting recipes are marked:
info.gregecore.genesiscrucible8: Cartridge multiblocks have a different colored casing on its upper and lower parts, find the same color on Genesis Crucible and form it there.
info.gregecore.quantumsynergizer2: This machine harvests residual quantum energy from completed crafts and applies it to the next operation.
info.gregecore.quantumsynergizer3: Each unique completed recipe generates 1 Combo Point. If you start the same recipe that you already used to get a Combo Point, they reset back to 1. Upon reaching 3 Combo Points, the next recipe will finish instantly.
info.gregecore.dysoncollector2: This machine collects the energy reflected from the solar sails, boosted by the amount of the launched solar sails.
info.gregecore.dysoncollector3: Energy output is multiplied by the amount of sails shot.
info.gregecore.dysonlauncher2: This machine launches solar sails into the sun orbit. Depending on the number of launched sails, various boosts are given to Dyson Swarm Energy Collector.
info.gregecore.dysonlauncher3: Energy output is multiplied by the amount of sails shot.
info.gregecore.ascencionaltar2: Last hurdle stands between you and godhood. The ancient skyblock gods say to give them their toll.
info.gregecore.ascencionaltar3: Find the lost tomes of skyblock knowledge. Each tome has its own riddle to solve. You can get clues on them in EMI. Then place them in the altars, one in each finger. Each craft needs a different tome.
info.gregecore.deepspaceexplorer2: Due to the immense strain put on your body by traveling at near-light speeds, you decided it is better to send unmanned drones into deep space. These autonomous units can travel vast distances without requiring maintenance or refueling, routinely sending back recovery probes with their findings. Utilize these returned exotic materials to manufacture revolutionary new technologies
info.gregecore.deepspaceexplorer3: Avaible drones & their avaible solar systems:
info.gregecore.deepspaceexplorer7: Put the drones in the drone access hatch.
info.gregecore.deepspaceexplorer8: Better drones can also reach the systems reachable by the previous drones.
info.gregecore.fornax2: One of the mysteries of cosmos lies at your feet. Create a sturdy rocket and make haste for the materials created by the black hole itself.
info.gregecore.fornax3: The black hole tries to crush your spaceship with inconceivable gravitational forces. You will need to repair the spaceship mid-flight to survive the voyage and come back home with the spoils. Supply correct items to the machine, you will know which is the correct one by the redstone signal. Failure to do so results in the machine exploding. Below are the repair items with their signal strength.
info.gregecore.fornax8: Tip: After correct formation, the first recipe is always repaired with Server Rack!
info.gregecore.fracture3: Eye of the Red Menace, Ysha'lotha
info.gregecore.fracture4: Eye of the Purple Stalker, Kal'dora
info.gregecore.fracture5: Eye of the Green Soldier, Ar'thas
info.gregecore.fracture6: And insert them into Reality Fracture Holders. Then you can open the rift with Infinity Catalyst.
info.gregecore.fracture7: Do not enter without full infinity gear. The dimension you are stepping into will kill you without it.
info.gregecore.starmaykr2: You have done it. You made a machine capable of making and sustaining stars. While some might say its useful for energy, you have different ideas. Using the immense gravitational forces inside a stars core, you just might forge unthinkable items.
info.gregecore.starmaykr3: Star starts with 1 x 10³⁰ tons. If your star drops below 0 or over 500 x 10³⁰ tons, the multiblock explodes. Each crafting recipe has some sort of weight cost, due to the star fusing some of its own weight into it whenever it forms a singularity. You can increase the weight of the star if you feed it correct items. The correct items are shown below with their weight value. Place them in the Star Feeder.
info.gregecore.antimatter2: Turn valuable materials into Antimatter. The more valuable the materials are, the more antimatter you will get.
info.gregecore.antimatter3: For every 100000 EMC value, you will get 1mb of Antimatter.
info.gregecore.specassembly1: Abilities: Perfect Overclock, Parallel Hatch and Threading
info.gregecore.elevator2: No longer a theoretical concept, the Space Elevator bridges the gap between planetary surface and orbit. Use it to accelerate resource generation.
info.gregecore.elevator3: Each recipe has a target height that needs to be set in the controller before the recipe can start.
info.gregecore.essentia1: Use this to input Aer Essentia to Infusion Altar.
info.gregecore.essentia2: Use this to input Aqua Essentia to Infusion Altar.

info.gregecore.essentia4: Use this to input Ordo Essentia to Infusion Altar.
info.gregecore.essentia5: Use this to input Perditio Essentia to Infusion Altar.
info.gregecore.essentia6: Use this to input Terra Essentia to Infusion Altar.
info.gregecore.advancedparallelbooster1: Use this to quadruple the parallels that the machine can achieve.
info.gregecore.parallelbooster1: Use this to double the parallels that the machine can achieve.
info.gregecore.textthreading1: Use this to enable threading on the compatible machines.
info.gregecore.pedestal1: Use this to input items to Infusion Altar.
info.gregecore.pressure1: Use this to input Steam into Pressure Chamber.

info.gregecore.bloodstorage1: Use this to input blood for Blood Cathedral.
info.gregecore.feeder1: Use this to feed the star items. Items are inserted every 5 ticks.
info.gregecore.repairinput1: Use this to input repair parts, which will be used to repair the spaceship.
info.gregecore.realityholder1: Use this to hold the ancient eyes.
info.gregecore.advancedheater1: Use this to input heater fluid into advanced machines.
info.gregecore.coolant1: Use this to input coolant into machines.
info.gregecore.coolantoutput1: Use this to output coolant from machines.
info.gregecore.advancedcoolant1: Use this to input coolant into advanced machines.
info.gregecore.fabricationarray2: Due to the densinty of the new materials, normal Assembly Lines won't cut it anymore. This machine is the upgraded version of the Assembly Lines, strong enough to handle almost every material.
info.gregecore.fabricationarray3: This machine needs you to insert the items in the correct order, the closest input bus to the controller is slot 1, the one behind is slot 2, etc.
block.gregecore.world_eater_tamer_casing: Very Dark Orange World Eater Casing
gregecore.world_eater.hint.reward: Free output space for the earned essence
gregecore.world_eater.hint.report: Free output space for the survey report
gregecore.world_eater.hint.survey: Insert an IV Sensor to survey nearby machines (500 needed)
gregecore.world_eater.hint.casing: Replace the casings in the middle with colored ones to upgrade to tier 2
gregecore.world_eater.hint.intention: Install a Safety or Bravery Hatch at the rear face center
gregecore.world_eater.hint.test: Insert Desarium to run the preparation test
gregecore.world_eater.hint.real: Ready: insert Implementium for real runs
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.0: Surveys machines in the surrounding 9×9 chunks; 500 awaken the tamer.
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.1: Frame: black World Eater Tamer Casing; inner rings: any World Eater casing color.
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.2: Any black inner-ring casing: tier 1; all colored: tier 2.
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.3: Tier 2 + intention hatch: Desarium tests ACTIVE → PREPARED; Implementium makes essence.
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.4: Deliver the displayed demand to any input bus before the deadline.
gregecore.tooltip.world_eater_tamer.5: Optional: one parallel hatch, one ME Demand Hatch, and an intention hatch at the rear face center.
gregecore.tooltip.safety_intention_hatch: Optional World Eater tamer part: rear face center, opposite the controller.
A real demand timeout destroys this hatch.
No collateral damage; test failures and cancellations are harmless.
gregecore.tooltip.bravery_intention_hatc: Optional World Eater tamer part: rear face center, opposite the controller.
A real demand timeout destroys one nearby machine of your team instead.
No collateral damage; test failures and cancellations are harmless.
gregecore.tooltip.me_demand_hatch.0: Optional World Eater tamer part: one per frame, at any I/O position.
gregecore.tooltip.me_demand_hatch.1: Mirrors the current real-run demand from ME storage and tries one autocraft for missing items.
gregecore.tooltip.me_demand_hatch.2: No retries; late products stay in ME storage.
gregecore.tooltip.creative_demand_patter: Crafts any World Eater demand item from 1 Iron Ingot in 2 seconds.
